info.name: EduSphere API
info.description:
Auth (Passport) + Courses + Categories API for the EduSphere LMS.

1. Set `base_url` in the collection variables (defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8000` for `php artisan serve`).
2. Run **Auth > Login (Admin)** or **Auth > Login (User)** first — the access token is captured automatically into `{{access_token}}` and reused by every other request's Bearer auth.
3. Seeded accounts (see `database/seeders/AdminUserSeeder.php`):
   - admin@example.com / 12345678 (role: admin)
   - user@example.com / 12345678 (role: user)
   - instructor@example.com / 12345678 (role: instructor)

response.name: 200 OK
200 OK

request.description: Browser-flow only — opens in a browser, not meant to be called as a JSON API request. Redirects to Google, then back to /api/v1/auth/social/google/callback.

request.description: q = search title/short_description. category = category or sub_category id. price = free | paid.
Send a Bearer token to get real is_enrolled/is_unlocked/quiz_score_summary for that user. Without a token (or for a non-enrolled user) paid lessons come back with is_locked: true and no video_url.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Backed by CheckoutService (Razorpay). course_ids is optional on Pay — omit it to check out whatever is currently in the DB cart.

request.description: Free courses (or already-fully-discounted carts) enroll immediately with no gateway involved. Paid courses return a Razorpay order to complete client-side, then call Verify.

response.name: 200 OK (paid course → Razorpay order created)
